name: Antariksha physiological-state indicator
algorithm: Multinomial logistic regression (softmax, L2, class-weighted), 30 s windows, 15 s hop

featureDescriptions.hr_delta: Heart rate minus personal relaxed baseline (bpm)
featureDescriptions.eda_delta_z: Electrodermal activity (sweat response) vs baseline, in baseline SDs
featureDescriptions.eda_slope: Electrodermal activity trend within the window (baseline SDs / min)
featureDescriptions.temp_slope: Skin temperature trend within the window (°C / min)
featureDescriptions.motion_mean: Mean movement intensity vs baseline (baseline SDs)

dataset.name: Non-EEG Dataset for Assessment of Neurological Status (v1.0.0)
dataset.authors: Birjandtalab J, Cogan D, Pouyan MB, Nourani M
dataset.licence: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
dataset.population: 20 healthy adult volunteers, laboratory protocol on Earth

limitations: Trained on 20 healthy volunteers on Earth with scripted stressors — not astronauts, not microgravity.
Indicates which lab stage the signal pattern most resembles; it does not measure stress, illness or performance.
Not a medical device, not diagnostic, and must never be used for fitness-for-duty or mission decisions.
Requires a personal relaxed baseline from the same sensor; outputs are unreliable without one.
